name: source records
rule: one line of catalog.jsonl.gz (a salt, a stereoisomer and a source-only row each count once)

name: identity-reconciled compounds
rule: family (repurposing_search.families: ChEMBL parent/child or InChIKey connectivity layer, plus source-only records merged by a GtoPdb ligand -> ChEMBL identifier chain) containing at least one ChEMBL record

name: compounds usable by the matching method
rule: S1 family with at least one ChEMBL curated mechanism on a Homo sapiens target whose action maps to INCREASE or DECREASE (direction_task.chembl_class; partial agonist, modulator, binding agent, etc. are direction-less) and is not excluded by source_artefacts.tsv

name: wider rule, for comparison: IT7 M-net usable (any source, signed, human stable id)
rule: usable_census.row_usability over every row of the S1 family (ChEMBL, GtoPdb-via-DGIdb, other DGIdb claims taken at face value); not nested in S2

name: wider rule, corroborated (a ChEMBL or GtoPdb row among the usable rows)
rule: as S2w restricted to ChEMBL and GtoPdb groups

name: compounds evaluated in a card or ranking unit
rule: S2 family that is a member of a ranking unit (unit_members.tsv family_id) or linked to a curated card (card_links.json)

name: ranking units with at least one catalogue family
comparable hypotheses (ranking)
rule: unit_needs.tsv row whose need direction is determinate (down/up/restore) and where at least one member family has an L2 state coherent or opposed, i.e. a compatible/opposite comparison is possible

name: comparable hypotheses (module need matching)
rule: S1 family linked by identifier to an intervention target of a need (not excluded) whose module label is consistent or opposed (need direction determinate and a role row couples the target to the need)
